summary: HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary (HIVE Bermuda 2026 Ltd.) issued $115M aggregate principal amount of 0% exchangeable senior notes due 2031, including full exercise of the initial purchasers' option for an additional $15M. The notes are general unsecured obligations guaranteed by HIVE. The initial exchange rate is 389.5029 shares per $1,000 principal (exchange price ~$2.57/share, a ~17.5% premium to the April 16, 2026 closing price). The notes mature April 15, 2031, are exchangeable at holder's option under conditions, and settle in cash/shares at issuer's election. The issuer may redeem after April 20, 2029 if the stock trades at 130%+ of the exchange price for 20+ days. Proceeds boost corporate treasury for general purposes. Watch dilution overhang and potential share price support from exchange premium.
